section.content: The utility model discloses a gene detection device for biological gene engineering, which comprises a box body, wherein a cover body is hinged on the upper side wall of the box body, rectangular cavities are symmetrically arranged on the left and right sides of the lower side wall of the box body, an electric heating rod is arranged in the left rectangular cavity, a semiconductor refrigerating sheet is arranged in the right rectangular cavity, a ring-shaped groove is arranged on the inner side wall of a placing groove, an annular heat insulating plate is fixedly arranged on the inner side wall of the ring-shaped groove, a first air duct is wound on the lower side of the inner side wall of the ring-shaped groove, and a second air duct is wound on the upper side of the inner side wall of the ring-shaped groove, the temperature environment at a laboratory dish can be effectively detected by using a temperature relay, and the temperature regulation and control are carried out by matching with the electric heating rod and the semiconductor refrigerating sheet, meanwhile, the heat exchange, thereby promoting the experiment detection work.

本实用新型公开了一种用于生物基因工程的基因检测设备，包括箱体，箱体的上侧壁铰接安装有盖体，箱体的下侧壁左右对称开设有矩形腔，左侧矩形腔的内部装配有电热杆，右侧矩形腔的内部装配有半导体制冷片，放置槽的内侧壁开设有环形槽，环形槽的内侧壁固定安装有环形隔热板，环形槽的内侧壁下侧缠绕有第一导气管，环形槽的内侧壁上侧缠绕有第二导气管，本实用新型利用温度继电器能够有效对实验皿处的温度环境进行检测，并配合电热杆和半导体制冷片对温度调节进行调控，同时温度会经过管道和盒体处完成热交换，令实验皿处的温度环境不会过快变化，便于细胞的生存及温度的调控，进而促进实验检测工作的进行。

Gene detection equipment for biological gene engineeringTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a genetic engineering technical field specifically is a genetic testing equipment for biological genetic engineering.

Background

The gene engineering is also called gene splicing technology and DNA recombination technology, and is based on molecular genetics as theory, taking modern methods of molecular biology and microbiology as means, genes from different sources are mapped according to a pre-designed blueprint, in vitro construction of hybrid DNA molecules, followed by introduction into living cells to alter the original genetic characteristics of an organism, obtain new varieties, and produce new products, and in the genetic testing process, has higher requirement on the survival temperature of experimental cells, and can bring certain influence on related experiments if the temperature environment cannot reach the standard or the temperature environment changes too fast when being adjusted, if a device capable of regulating temperature and making temperature change more smooth and effective can be designed, such problems can be solved, and therefore, a gene detection device for biological gene engineering is provided.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

An object of the utility model is to provide a gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineering to solve the problem that proposes among the above-mentioned background art.

In order to achieve the above object, the utility model provides a following technical scheme: a gene detection device for biological gene engineering comprises a box body, wherein a cover body is hinged to the upper side wall of the box body, a placing groove is formed in the upper side wall of the box body, a rectangular cavity is symmetrically formed in the left side and the right side of the lower side wall of the box body, an electric heating rod is assembled in the rectangular cavity in the left side, a semiconductor refrigerating sheet is assembled in the rectangular cavity in the right side, a first air inlet and a second air inlet are fixedly installed in the front side wall of the box body in a bilateral symmetry mode, an air outlet is fixedly installed in the rear side wall of the box body, a ring groove is formed in the inner side wall of the placing groove, an annular heat insulation plate is fixedly installed on the inner side wall of the ring groove, a first air guide pipe is wound on the lower side of the inner side wall of the ring groove, the, and the second air duct is communicated with the air outlet and the right side, the rectangular cavity and the second air inlet are communicated, temperature relays are fixedly arranged on the left side and the right side of the inner side wall of the cover body in a bilateral symmetry mode, and the two temperature relays are connected in series with the electric heating rod, the external power supply, the semiconductor refrigerating sheet and the external power supply through wires respectively.

Preferably, the box body is fixedly arranged on the inner side wall of the placing groove.

Preferably, an annular groove is formed in the upper side wall of the box body, a rubber ring is fixedly mounted on the lower side wall of the cover body, and the rubber ring is inserted into the annular groove.

Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effects of the utility model are that: the utility model discloses a box, the lid, the electric heat pole, the semiconductor refrigeration piece, first air inlet, the second air inlet, first air duct, the second air duct, gas outlet and temperature relay's structure, utilize temperature relay can effectively detect the temperature environment of laboratory dish department, and cooperation electric heat pole and semiconductor refrigeration piece regulate and control temperature regulation, the heat exchange can be accomplished through pipeline and box body department to the temperature simultaneously, the temperature environment of making laboratory dish department can not change at an excessive rate, the regulation and control of the existence of the cell of being convenient for and temperature, and then the going on of promotion experiment detection achievement.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be described clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only some embodiments of the present invention, not all embodiments. Based on the embodiments in the present invention, all other embodiments obtained by a person skilled in the art without creative work belong to the protection scope of the present invention.

Referring to fig. 1 and fig. 2, the present invention provides a technical solution: a gene detection device for biological gene engineering comprises a box body 1, a cover body 2 is hinged on the upper side wall of the box body 1, a placing groove 3 is arranged on the upper side wall of the box body 1, a laboratory dish is placed in the placing groove 3, rectangular cavities 5 are symmetrically arranged on the left and right of the lower side wall of the box body 1, an electric heating rod 6 is assembled in the left rectangular cavity 5, the electric heating rod 6 is electrified to generate heat, a semiconductor refrigerating sheet 7 is assembled in the right rectangular cavity 5, the semiconductor refrigerating sheet 7 is electrified to refrigerate the upper surface, the lower surface generates heat, a baffle plate at the lower side of the right rectangular cavity 5 is a grid plate, heat dissipation is facilitated, a first air inlet 8 and a second air inlet 9 are symmetrically and fixedly arranged on the left and right of the front side wall of the box body 1, an air outlet 10 is fixedly arranged on the rear side wall of the box body, avoid carrying on the heat exchange between the first air duct 13 and the second air duct 14, the inside wall downside of the ring channel 11 is twined with the first air duct 13, and the first air duct 13 is linked with the air outlet 10 and the left side rectangular cavity 5, the first air inlet 8, through this air circulation mode, realize the heating up treatment in the standing groove 3, the inside wall upside of the ring channel 11 is twined with the second air duct 14, and the second air duct 14 is linked with the air outlet 10 and the right side rectangular cavity 5, the second air inlet 9, through this air circulation mode, realize the cooling treatment in the standing groove 4, the inside wall bilateral symmetry of the lid body 2 is fixedly equipped with the temperature relay 15, two temperature relays 15 respectively through wire and electric hot rod 6, external power supply and semiconductor refrigeration piece 7, external power supply series, monitor the temperature environment in the standing groove 3 through the temperature relay 15, and whether the electric heating rod 6 and the semiconductor refrigerating sheet 7 are electrified or not is controlled respectively, so that the temperature environment in the placing groove 3 is regulated and controlled.

Particularly, the inside wall fixed mounting of standing groove 3 has box body 4, avoids first air duct 13 and second air duct 14 department directly to carry out the heat exchange with the test ware in the standing groove 3, reduces heat conduction efficiency, is convenient for regulate and control the temperature environment in the standing groove 3.

Particularly, annular groove 16 has been seted up to the last lateral wall of box 1, and the lower lateral wall fixed mounting of lid 2 has rubber ring 17, and rubber ring 17 pegs graft in annular groove 16, increases the gas tightness, avoids entering such as external bacterium.

The working principle is as follows: this a gene check out test set for biological gene engineering, place the experiment ware in box body 4 of standing groove 3 back, cover lid 2, and the circular telegram, temperature relay 15 can monitor temperature environment in standing groove 3 this moment, when the temperature exceedes the settlement temperature condition, can carry out the circular telegram control to electric heat pole 6 and semiconductor refrigeration piece 7 respectively, when the temperature is lower, electric heat pole 6 circular telegram and semiconductor refrigeration piece 7 outage, suitably improve the temperature in the standing groove 3, when the temperature is higher, electric heat pole 6 outage and semiconductor refrigeration piece 7 circular telegram, suitably reduce the temperature in the standing groove 3, realize effectual temperature regulation and control, be convenient for realize and going on of detection.

Although embodiments of the present invention have been shown and described, it will be appreciated by those skilled in the art that changes, modifications, substitutions and alterations can be made in these embodiments without departing from the principles and spirit of the invention, the scope of which is defined in the appended claims and their equivalents.
